about: Every case of the macos-engines CI job, by name; scripts/ci-junit-summary.py fails the job on any difference.
required: passes on the hosted macOS VM. physicalMac: skipped there, passes on a physical Mac (scripts/webots-physical-mac.py) before a release reaches main.
Observed on hosted arm64 VMs (macos-15, macos-26): WB02 lidar ranges disagree with the ray-cast. The other five physicalMac cases failed there too; that the lidar causes them is a hypothesis.
